meta_title: Nurelo: software for home care, care homes and emergency call
meta_desc: Nurelo brings home care, residential care and home emergency call services together on one platform: route planning, documentation, billing and TI-KIM.
og_desc: Three care settings, one platform: route planning, care documentation, billing and TI-KIM.
ld_desc: Care management software for home care services, residential care facilities and home emergency call providers.
hero_lead: Nurelo brings home care, residential care and home emergency call services together on one platform, with route planning, documentation, billing and TI-KIM connection.
mock_aria: Preview of the Nurelo interface: timeline with the residential care, home care and emergency call modules
st_h2: Your care home, organised in one system.
am_h2: Your companion for care routes and home visits.
hn_h2: Your overview of service users, devices and alarms.
pf_lead: Each product works with its own master data and its own modules by default. On request, several products can share one database.
f1_p: Voice input and text suggestions reduce documentation effort. Nurelo learns from your patterns.
f2_p: Billing with payers, automatic invoice creation and exports for accounting and payroll.
f3_p: Secure communication with doctors, health insurers and other providers through the German telematics infrastructure.
f4_p: Granular access control for nursing directors, care staff, accounting and administration, with audit log.
f5_p: Statistics for quality inspections and a report designer for your own print templates.
f6_p: Whether installed on your premises or hosted in Germany: new features and legal changes are applied automatically.
ml_lead: Care staff speak in their own language, Nurelo documents in German.
ml_t1: User interface available in over 10 languages, with more to follow
ml_t2: Check and correct the translation before saving
ml_t3: Translation carried out locally at your premises or on our servers in Germany
ml_orig: Mrs Weber ate all of her lunch and drank two glasses of water. She was transferred to her wheelchair without any problems.
on_lead: Nurelo is ready to use within a few days, with personal support.
s2_p: Set-up for your care setting, including master data import.
s3_p: On-site or online training for care service managers and staff, plus a video library.
s4_p: Going live with personal support during the first weeks.
pr_lead: We will prepare a quote tailored to your facility, with no hidden costs.
pdd1: One care setting or all three: residential, home care and emergency call.
pdd2: Small services up to 20 user accounts, larger organisations without limit.
pdd3: Add-on modules such as route planning, document archive or report designer as needed.
pdd4: Exports for DATEV and SAP as well as the TI-KIM connection.
pdd5: E-mail support or priority support, with a dedicated account manager for operators.
pdd6: Individual solutions for several facilities, SLA by agreement.
ct_lead: We will show you Nurelo in a personal demo and answer your questions. Our team supports you from the start.
ft_desc: Care management software for home care services, residential care facilities and home emergency call providers. Developed in Germany.
